title: airella capillaris
intro: Airella capillaris, commonly known as sea fennel or saltwort, is a type of coastal shrub that grows in salt-marshes and coastal areas. It has been used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Airella capillaris include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
